title: SimDiff: Depth pruning via similarity and difference
selection_reason: SimDiff prunes redundant LLM layers using both representation similarity and transformation difference; the publisher abstract reports >91% retained LLaMA2-7B performance at 25% pruning and up to 1.49x inference speedup on LLaMA3.1-8B.
